args.note: For a porous solid made of one isotropic linear-elastic material and void, the Voigt variational bound C_eff <= phi C_s implies E100_eff <= phi E_s. With amm PA12 E_s=1700 MPa and phi<=0.29, E100_eff<=493 MPa <592 MPa. Thus the requirements are incompatible for all allowed geometries, independent of cell size. A necessary (not sufficient) volume fraction is 592/1700=0.3482353, or 34.82%; alternatively at 29% the solid would need E_s>=2041.38 MPa. Manufacturability is not evaluated.
